squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.1: Each contestant sits at a desk with four closed honeycomb tins. Pick one: what is inside is pure luck - a circle, a triangle, a star or the dreaded umbrella.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.2: Carve the shape out of the cookie with the needle: hold the left mouse button and trace the groove. The shape is free once enough of the line is carved.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.3: Go slowly and stay on the line. A fast or wandering needle raises the cookie's stress, thin tips and corners are the most fragile spots, and at 100 the cookie cracks - a cracked cookie means elimination.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.4: Right mouse button or L: lick the cookie. The warm sugar softens and the stress drops. You have %s licks and each needs a moment before the next.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.5: You have %s seconds, tin selection included. The shape is free at %s%% of the line carved. Anyone whose cookie is not free when time runs out is eliminated.
squidgame.game.dalgona.instruction.6: If you close the carving table with Esc the clock keeps running: right-click your desk to reopen it. Difficulty: %s.
